mapper.select: SELECT i.itemid AS itemId, i.listprice AS listPrice, i.unitcost AS unitCost, i.supplier AS supplierId, i.status, i.attr1 AS attribute1, i.attr2 AS attribute2, i.attr3 AS attribute3, i.attr4 AS attribute4, i.attr5 AS attribute5, v.qty AS quantity, p.productid AS "product.productId", p.category AS "product.categoryId", p.name AS "product.name", p.descn AS "product.description" FROM item i, inventory v, product p WHERE p.productid = i.productid AND i.itemid = v.itemid AND i.itemid = #{itemId}
